intro.zh: 清华大学未央书院毕业，具备数理与能源工程背景。关注 AI 应用开发与科学机器学习，实践涵盖工程场景中的 AI 助手、结合物理先验的神经网络预测，以及 AI 决策与软件系统的集成。
intro.en: Tsinghua University graduate with a background in mathematics, physics, and energy engineering. I work on AI applications and scientific machine learning: engineering assistants, neural prediction with physical priors, and AI decisions integrated into software.

description.zh: 段培耀 / Peiyao Duan。清华大学毕业，关注 AI 应用开发、科学机器学习与软件工程。查看 AI 助手、PyTorch 神经网络预测、AI 决策集成等项目，以及中英文求职简历。
description.en: Peiyao Duan — Tsinghua University graduate working on AI applications, scientific machine learning, and software engineering. AI assistants, PyTorch neural prediction, AI decision integration, and a bilingual résumé.

about.zh: 我希望把数理基础与软件实现结合起来，参与 AI 应用和机器学习相关的研发工作。已有实践覆盖 PyTorch 代理模型、文字与语音助手，以及实时应用中的 AI 决策集成。我关注训练与验证是否可复现，也关注模型接入后的状态管理、失败回退和用户交互。
about.en: I am seeking development roles in AI applications and machine learning, combining a mathematical foundation with software implementation. My projects span PyTorch surrogate models, text and voice assistants, and AI decisions in real-time applications. I focus on reproducible evaluation, state management, failure handling, and usable interfaces.
